[[File:Barriss.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Barriss Offee performed the compass dance during the mission to Ansion.]]
{{Quote|I've practiced it before, Master. I know it's a dangerous move, but we do want to make as strong an impression as possible on these people so that they'll help us.|Barriss Offee, to Luminara Unduli|<ref name="The Approaching Storm">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
The '''compass dance''' was a type of dance.<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref> It consisted of [[Acrobat/Legends|acrobatic]] jumps around the cardinal points on the floor and twirling of a weapon. During the [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|Mission to Ansion]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] performed the dance using [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Barriss Offee's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to impress the [[Highborn]] [[Mazong]] and his [[Yiwa]] clan.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The compass dance first appeared in the [[2002]] novel ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' by [[Alan Dean Foster]],<ref name="The Approaching Storm" /> and was first identified as such in the [[2004]] novel ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'', written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]].<ref name="MedStar II" />
